verify.note: Reads the code with comments stripped: the orders module reads the ledger, binds a seller read to that seller kind and filters the lines to theirs, and returns a share; both seller surfaces render the share line; the operator page renders the transfer ledger (data-order-transfers) and a retry action exists; the retry reopens a stuck row one under the ceiling and pays through executePlannedTransfers. Fails on the LIVE-622 base at its first arm. Cannot see rendered figures or a live transfer; lib/commerce/orders-split.test.ts owns the share arithmetic and the isolation, components/marketplace/split-order-surfaces.test.tsx the rendered surfaces, lib/commerce/transfer-retry.test.ts the retry.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1616). RE-TESTED first on the LIVE-622 head: listOrdersForSeller filtered owner_profile_id, listSpaceOrders and spaceEarningsSummary filtered owner_space_id, a split order carries neither, and /admin/marketplace/orders never read commerce_order_transfers. SHIPPED, no migration. (1) lib/commerce/orders.ts: the two seller reads union the orders a seller owns with the split orders carrying a transfer row for them (matched on owner_kind AND the owner id), each returned as that seller's view (sellerViewOfSplitOrder): their lines only (a line's seller is its product's owner, now joined), amountCents and platformFeeCents replaced by their share's gross and fee, fulfilment recomputed from their lines, and share = { grossCents, feeCents, netCents, reversedCents, transferStatus }. An unreadable ledger is logged and leaves the owned orders listed. spaceEarningsSummary grows a split-share arm: the share, not the cart; a refunded order moves the share; a partial refund comes off the share pro rata; never the network slice. Every CommerceOrder now carries fundsFlow and sellerCount. (2) OrderShareNote (components/marketplace/order-share-note.tsx) on the Space Shop Orders tab and the maker console: "Your share of a N-seller order", the net after the fee, and a payout badge; the fulfilment control is read-only on a split order there (setOrderFulfillment binds to owner columns a split order leaves null). The buyer's /orders lists a split order's lines under each seller's name. (3) OrderTransferLedger (components/marketplace/order-transfer-ledger.tsx) under every split order, and only a split order, on /admin/marketplace/orders at [data-order-transfers]: seller, net, fee kept, attempts, transfer id, reversed cents, last error, Stuck at the ceiling, and "could not be read" rather than "no transfers". retryOrderTransferAction (requireOperator) calls retryOrderTransfer (lib/commerce/transfer-retry.ts, new, on the admin-client baseline): refuses a landed row and a row of a refunded or never-completed order, lifts a stuck row's attempts to ONE under the ceiling (compare-and-set, never zero, so the adoption lookup still runs), then pays through executePlannedTransfers. lib/commerce/transfers.ts unchanged. NOT HERE: item (4), the refund button's pro rata wording, belongs with LIVE-623's reversal; the seller's sale notice and the buyer receipt email for a split order (order-receipt.ts still sends the buyer half only), and a fulfilment door for a split order, are follow-ups. TESTS: lib/commerce/orders-split.test.ts (11, against a mock that applies its filters: a Space and a maker each see their own share and status and none of the other's lines, figures, ids or error; a destination order has no share; the kind match; earnings sum the share with refunds pro rata; an unreadable ledger), lib/commerce/transfer-retry.test.ts (5), components/marketplace/split-order-surfaces.test.tsx (6: the share line, every ledger row with a retry only where not landed, and the admin page rendering a ledger for the split order only). Mutation-fired: dropping the owner_kind match or the line filter fails a test. PROBE: red on the LIVE-622 head at its first arm, green here.
